docs/README.md:91 describes config.md as covering the removed .rebar/config.conf flat-key format rather than the current rebar.toml/[tool.rebar] table structure
pyproject.toml:488-490 comment claims non-core mypy checking is advisory-only, but CI gates (Makefile:248, _build-and-test.yml) enforce mypy over the whole library and scripts/
